title: 从检测到拒绝：通过电路引导的权重缩放实现更安全的LLM
summary: 本文从机制可解释性角度研究LLM安全，识别出多阶段安全电路（有害检测头、安全神经元、拒绝头），并通过权重缩放干预，在六个LLM上使攻击下的安全率提升26.5%，同时标准基准准确率仅下降1.7%。
summary_en: This paper studies LLM safety from a mechanistic interpretability perspective, identifying a multi-stage safety circuit (harmful detection heads, safety neurons, refusal heads). Circuit-guided weight scaling improves safety rates under attacks by 26.5% across six LLMs with only 1.7% accuracy drop.
